{{Top|leg}}
'''Holovision''' was a media device that streamed images and sounds and featured many [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]], as well as [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] and later [[Imperial HoloVision]]. Many [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] were known to watch holovision, particularly [[Josie]].
